calculation.expression: during lagged VIX shock regime: -sum(asset_return, 3d), cross-sectionally demeaned
calculation.description: When the lagged one-day VIX change is above its trailing 60-day 75th percentile, rank assets by the negative of their preceding three-day return. The signal is inactive outside shock regimes and is computed only from completed observations.

validation.regime_notes: Daily cross-sectional validation on the 15-instrument tradable benchmark. Five-day horizon passes absolute IC >= 0.0070 and absolute ICIR >= 0.0840. Shock observations are sparse and regime-dependent; uncertainty is interpreted conservatively.
